mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bid (goods_id, user_account, price, create_time, bidder_code) VALUES (#{goodsId}, #{userAccount}, #{price}, NOW(), #{bidderCode})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM bid WHERE goods_id = #{goodsId} AND user_account = #{userAccount} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: update bid set goods_id = #{goodsId}, user_account = #{userAccount}, price = #{price}, create_time = NOW(), bidder_code = #{bidderCode} where id = #{id}
